## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] A new check tests one thing and returns a reason with its verdict
- [ ] New inspector facts or checks have a test
- [ ] No client data, real tasks, answer keys or secrets in code, tests or sample files
- [ ] README or the example updated if behaviour changed
